1-1.title: World 1-1: Grassland Inception
1-1.desc: Iconic overworld with green pipes, Goombas, and Flagpole victory.

1-2.title: World 1-2: Subterranean Caverns
1-2.desc: Blue brick ceiling running, Piranha Plants, Buzzy Beetles, and Warp Zone.

1-3.title: World 1-3: Mushroom Treetops
1-3.desc: High-altitude bouncy mushrooms, precision platforming across abyssal chasms.

1-4.title: World 1-4: Bowser's Lava Fortress
1-4.desc: Stone corridors, spinning firebars, lava pits, and Bowser's bridge axe.

2-1.title: World 2-1: Daybreak Plains
2-1.desc: Overworld with high brick staircases, jumping Koopa Troopas, and springboards.

2-2.title: World 2-2: Coral Deep Sea
2-2.desc: Buoyant underwater swimming physics, Bloopers, and Cheep Cheeps.

2-3.title: World 2-3: Flying Fish Bridge
2-3.desc: Endless ocean bridge besieged by leaping red and grey Cheep Cheeps.

2-4.title: World 2-4: Fortress of Embers
2-4.desc: Submerged fire chains, falling ceiling obstacles, and bridge combat.

3-1.title: World 3-1: Twilight Prairie
3-1.desc: Nocturnal overworld featuring Super Stars, Koopa Paratroopas, and Piranha pipes.

3-2.title: World 3-2: The Buzzy Thicket
3-2.desc: Dense formations of fire-resistant Buzzy Beetles and precision sprint runs.

3-3.title: World 3-3: Cloud Mushroom Heights
3-3.desc: Vertiginous lift-balancing pulleys suspended over bottomless voids.

3-4.title: World 3-4: Bowser's Redoubt
3-4.desc: Complex firebar gauntlet with narrow footing over bubbling magma.

4-1.title: World 4-1: Lakitu's Cloud Assault
4-1.desc: Open sky with Lakitu dropping airborne Spiny eggs from clouds above.

4-2.title: World 4-2: The Deep Hollow
4-2.desc: Expansive subterranean maze with elevator platforms and hidden vines.

4-3.title: World 4-3: Giant Mushroom Ridge
4-3.desc: Massive red and green mushroom tops with extreme leap gaps.

4-4.title: World 4-4: The Labyrinth Keep
4-4.desc: Infamous looping maze puzzle; wrong paths trap the player in an infinite loop.

5-1.title: World 5-1: Highland Tundra
5-1.desc: Winterized palette, high-speed Bullet Bills firing from cannons.

5-2.title: World 5-2: Hammer Bros Gauntlet
5-2.desc: Long endurance trail guarded by aggressive projectile-throwing Hammer Bros.

5-3.title: World 5-3: Treetop Aerials
5-3.desc: Narrow wooden bridges and bouncing mushroom stems high in the canopy.

5-4.title: World 5-4: Molten Bastion
5-4.desc: Fast double firebars and low-ceiling jumps across boiling lava pools.

6-1.title: World 6-1: Twilight Ridge
6-1.desc: Dark sky, relentless Lakitu bombardment, and steep pipe formations.

6-2.title: World 6-2: The Pipe Maze
6-2.desc: Dense cluster of 12 green pipes containing biting Piranha Plants.

6-3.title: World 6-3: Midnight Stems
6-3.desc: Eerie dark mushroom platforms requiring maximum ballistic momentum.

6-4.title: World 6-4: Infernal Keep
6-4.desc: Multi-tiered firebars with aggressive Bowser fireball volleys.

7-1.title: World 7-1: Bullet Bill Alley
7-1.desc: Dense artillery battery of Bill Blasters firing in rapid succession.

7-2.title: World 7-2: Abyssal Reef
7-2.desc: Extreme underwater hazard density with homing Bloopers and Cheep swarms.

7-3.title: World 7-3: Oceanic Flying Bridge
7-3.desc: Furious wave of airborne Cheep Cheeps raining across narrow footing.

7-4.title: World 7-4: The False Mazes
7-4.desc: Complex four-tier branching castle maze leading to Bowser's sanctum.

8-1.title: World 8-1: The Final Frontier
8-1.desc: The longest continuous sprint level in the game with extreme gap leaps.

8-2.title: World 8-2: Paratroopa Barrage
8-2.desc: High bouncing green Paratroopas and flying Bullet Bills over deep pits.

8-3.title: World 8-3: The Hammer Fortress
8-3.desc: Castle exterior defended by squads of charging, jumping Hammer Bros.

8-4.title: World 8-4: Bowser's Dark Citadel
8-4.desc: Final multi-room pipe maze transitioning from castle to underwater to lava bridge.
